lines.zh: 发出微弱的铃声，消失在视线中。
阴影中的幻影缓缓前行。
发出银铃般的笑声，飘过树林。
lines.en: Silver laughter drifts through the forest.

lines.zh: 发出尖锐的叫声，快速消失。
在阴影中游走，难以察觉。
lines.en: Wanders in shadows, hard to spot.

lines.zh: 悄无声息地移动，如同夜幕。
lines.en: Moves silently, like a dark night.

lines.zh: 在月光下显现，又消失不见。
金铃轻晃，它踩着铃声前行。
lines.en: The golden bell sways, and it walks to the chime.

lines.zh: 它走过的地方留下两道影子。
lines.en: It leaves two shadows wherever it passes.
Bell hangs quietly on the branch.
Stares at the player, eyes eerie.

lines.zh: 发出微弱的嗡鸣声，仿佛咒语。
lines.en: Sends out a faint hum, like a spell.
Scans the area, searching for a target.

lines.zh: 偶尔发出一阵响亮的铃声。
金铃铛挂在枝头，替它放哨。
lines.en: Its golden bell hangs on a branch, keeping watch.
It practices changing faces at a puddle.

lines.zh: 它在数自己有几个分身。
lines.en: It is counting how many doubles it has.

lines.zh: 它把玩着金铃，念一半的咒。
lines.en: It toys with the bell, murmuring half a spell.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，眼睛中映出无数幻影。
lines.en: Stares at the player, eyes reflecting multiple illusions.

lines.zh: 突然出现，仿佛从空气中浮现。
lines.en: Suddenly appears, as if from thin air.

lines.zh: 发出轻微的笑声，注视玩家。
lines.en: Sends out a soft laugh, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 身影在玩家周围游走，如影随形。
lines.en: Form roams around the player, following like a shadow.

lines.zh: 发出诡异的叫声，引起玩家注意。
lines.en: Sends out an eerie call, drawing attention.

lines.zh: 凝视玩家，双眼闪烁着绿光。
lines.en: Stares at the player, eyes glowing green.

lines.zh: 在玩家周围飞舞，发出铃声。
突然消失，让玩家感到恐惧。
在玩家周围制造幻影，迷惑玩家。
lines.en: Creates illusions around the player, confusing them.

lines.zh: 它眨了下眼，你身后多了个自己。
lines.en: It blinks, and another you appears behind you.

lines.zh: 它歪头看你，像在挑一张脸。
lines.en: It tilts its head, as if choosing a face to wear.

lines.zh: 你看见两个它，同时望过来。
lines.en: You see two of it looking at you at once.

lines.zh: 它把你的影子变薄了一点。
lines.en: It thins your shadow by a hair.

lines.zh: 金铃在你头顶响了一声。
lines.en: The golden bell rings once above your head.

lines.zh: 它用分身围住你的视线。
lines.en: It rings your sight with decoys.

lines.zh: 它抬手，你面前浮出错觉。
lines.en: It raises a hand and a false image swims before you.

lines.zh: 它在你眼里放进一朵假的火。
lines.en: It plants a false flame in your eyes.
The doubles are gone, but the pain is real.

lines.zh: 它金铃铛一响，虚影乱舞。
lines.en: Its jingling bells summon illusory dancers.
Its form is both real and false.
Illusions trick you to your death.
It uses illusions to avoid collisions.

lines.zh: 它的幻术在碰撞中破碎。

lines.en: Doubles seek mates, real and false.
It uses illusions to attract mates.

lines.zh: 金铃铛里藏着狡猾的分身！
lines.en: A tricky decoy in the golden bell.

lines.zh: 滴溜溜，你的幻觉开始了！
它挑中你的脸，准备借用。
lines.en: It picks your face and means to borrow it.

lines.zh: 它把你的模样记进幻术里。
lines.en: It files your likeness away in its illusions.

lines.zh: 它绕着圈，缩小你的视野。
lines.en: It circles closer, shrinking your field of view.
It decides you will never catch it.
At one chime of the bell, it sets the stage.

lines.zh: 它把诱饵放在你必经的路。
lines.en: It leaves a lure on the path you must take.
It hides among its doubles and watches you.

lines.zh: 它选中你做这场戏的主角。
lines.en: It casts you as the lead in this little play.

lines.zh: 它窥视着你的每一个动作...
它的注意力集中在你身上...
它拨响金铃，幻影朝你涌来。
lines.en: It rings the bell and phantoms pour toward you.

lines.zh: 分身排成圈，把你围在中间。
lines.en: Its doubles form a ring around you.

lines.zh: 它在三步外捏出一把假剑。
lines.en: Three paces away, it shapes a false blade.

lines.zh: 它的指尖凝出一枚幻术符。
lines.en: An illusion sigil forms at its fingertip.
You hear the bell from every direction.
It turns the exit into a wall.

lines.zh: 它抬起手，影子开始扭曲。
lines.en: It lifts a hand and the shadows warp.

lines.zh: 它把你的脚印指给分身看。
lines.en: It points your footprints out to its doubles.

lines.zh: 它准备好了，只等你伸手。
lines.en: It is ready, waiting for you to reach out.

lines.zh: 铃声响第二次，幻术就成。
lines.en: The second chime completes the illusion.

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，幻影般袭来。

lines.en: Warps space, trying to grab you.

lines.zh: 闪烁消失，突然出现在你身旁。
lines.en: Flickers away, suddenly appearing beside you.

lines.zh: 施放分身，包围你的四周。
迅速变换位置，难以捉摸。
lines.en: Changes positions quickly, hard to pin down.

lines.zh: 化作烟雾逃走，再寻时机。
lines.en: Escapes in a cloud of smoke, waiting for another chance.

lines.zh: 分身先撞上来，真身在后。
lines.en: A double strikes first; the real one follows.

lines.zh: 它用幻影换掉你的准头。
lines.en: It trades your aim for a phantom.
The bell clangs sharply and your ears ring.

lines.zh: 它从你背后递来一记幻术。
lines.en: It slips a spell into your back.

lines.zh: 假象破裂，真身已经贴脸。
lines.en: The image bursts and the true one is in your face.

lines.zh: 它把你的视线缠成一团。
lines.en: It tangles your sight into a knot.

lines.zh: 以金铃铛为标记，现身于此。
lines.en: Appears where the golden bell is.
Appears slowly from the golden bell.

lines.zh: 金铃一响，林中多出一道虚影。
lines.en: One chime, and a wraith joins the woods.

lines.zh: 它从你的倒影里钻出来。
lines.en: It crawls out of your reflection.
The bell lands, and it takes shape after it.

lines.zh: 它从宝典的书页间跳下。
lines.en: It hops down from between the tome's pages.

lines.zh: 你翻到那一页，它就在那儿。
lines.en: You turn to that page, and there it is.
A thread of bell-song knits it together.

lines.zh: 它先在远处现形，再走近。
lines.en: It appears far off first, then walks closer.

lines.zh: 金铃挂在树上，等它回来。
lines.en: The golden bell hangs in the tree, waiting for it.
The bell scalds, my illusion burns through!
Shadows in the water cannot save me!
The arrow passed the double and hit me!

lines.zh: 我的幻术被更强的法术撕开！
lines.en: A stronger spell tore my illusion open!

lines.zh: 雷光把幻影照得无处可藏！
lines.en: Lightning leaves my phantoms nowhere to hide!
